content.short: Eisen provides customizable Ethena.Fi for Ce-DeFi hybrid yield strategies.
content.description: Eisen blends DeFi and CeFi by operating as a hybrid Ce-DeFi platform that combines DEX aggregators with CEX liquidity to optimize trading outcomes. It addresses challenges such as price impact, slippage, and fragmented liquidity by using sophisticated routing algorithms designed to secure more favorable executions across multiple chains and exchanges. By linking liquidity across multiple networks, Eisen aims to provide smoother price discovery, reduced slippage, and more reliable routing for traders and institutions alike, while preserving user control and transparency.
